auth_type.correction: api_key (JWT API token from user account; Authorization: Bearer or JWT). Entry uses type "jwt" which is nonstandard for this directory pattern — token is a self-serve JWT API token, not OAuth2-only. Prefer documenting as API token/JWT per official self-serve token page.

free_tier_limits.correction: Free public API with no paid plans. Exact free-tier numeric quotas are not cleanly published as "~100 unauth / higher auth"; rely on response rate-limit headers and current community/docs guidance rather than fixed published numbers.

rate_limits.correction: Do not state unauthenticated ~100/min and authenticated ~1000/min as established published limits; official docs emphasize checking rate-limit headers and that authenticated access gets higher limits. Community figures vary and are not authoritative fixed quotas.

notes: Adversarial check: base_url and docs_url are live. Auth is a user JWT API token (often labeled jwt) with optional unauth reads — type naming is the main ambiguity. Rate-limit numbers (~100/min unauth, ~1000/min auth) are the weak/hallucination-prone claims and should not be treated as confirmed published limits. No shutdown found.
